text: S704 correction to S703 units wording: the exact source DXF header declares centimeters with $INSUNITS=5. The first S703 JSON parser only inventoried group-0 entities and therefore omitted the header variable. The actual CLO AC1009 return has no $INSUNITS and replaces source semantic layers with numeric layers. S703 packet and C:-only report are corrected; no unit-only source-code fix or receiver inference is claimed.
